encounters.cc: Patient with opioid use disorder seeks help to quit heroin use and requests treatment

lines: Patient with opioid use disorder seeks help to quit heroin use and requests treatment
He has been using heroin daily for the past year and has tried to quit multiple times but has been unsuccessful.
He now wants help to quit.
His physician recommends starting buprenorphine.
During the visit, the patient's girlfriend says to the doctor, "How can you give him another drug to stop it? Please don't prescribe it to him!"

encounters.cc: Sharp, shooting pain in left lower limb affecting prosthetic limb use

lines: Sharp, shooting pain in left lower limb affecting prosthetic limb use
The patient is a 30-year-old male with opioid use disorder and chronic pain evaluated for substance use treatment.
He returns with pain in left lower limb which has been worsening over the past 3 months.
It is localized and intensifies with pressure.
It affects his ability to wear his prosthetic limb.

encounters.cc: Worsening restlessness, insomnia, muscle aches, and gastrointestinal symptoms

lines: Worsening restlessness, insomnia, muscle aches, and gastrointestinal symptoms

This 31-year-old male with severe recurrent opioid use disorder, asplenia, and chronic pain syndrome following amputation, seen in Jan 2020 for heroin use and July 2020 for prosthetic limb pain, is brought to the emergency department by his partner because of several days of worsening restlessness and inability to sleep.
He reports muscle aches, abdominal cramping, and episodes of nausea and diarrhea.
Over the past 2 days he has also experienced rhinorrhea, watery eyes, and frequent yawning.
He feels extremely anxious and describes "goosebumps" on his skin that come and go.

encounters.cc: Agitation and sweating immediately following release from incarceration

lines: Agitation and sweating immediately following release from incarceration

The patient is a 34-year-old male with severe recurrent opioid use disorder, asplenia, and chronic pain syndrome status post amputation who returns following recent incarceration, having previously presented with opioid withdrawal in March 2021 and heroin overdoses in September 2021 and May 2022.
He is brought to the emergency department by his friends.
He was released from prison 6 hours ago, where he served a 2-year sentence for drug possession.
His friends mention that he has a history of heroin use but claim he has been clean for the past year.
His friends are concerned he might have used heroin shortly before his symptoms started.
He complains of abdominal cramps, nausea, and an intense craving for opioids.
